title: Banjo or bass in Celestin's band
summary: Russell checks whether Kimball played banjo or bass on the Biloxi job and records.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Well, I wanted to check once more on the Solid Stan band. Did you play banjo or was it bass in the Biloxi?
I played banjo. Banjo. During that time, banjo.
Simon and Marrero were still on bass then? Yes. And when you made the records, were you on bass?
Oh, I can never remember. Because they have it that way up here, but down here the other one said you were on bass. No, on banjo.
Yes. Did you ever play on any jobs at all, bass with Celestan in the later years?
